title: Erdos #205: Powers of 2 plus numbers with few prime factors

problemStatement.formal: \exists^\infty n,\, \forall k\, (2^k < n \Rightarrow \Omega(n - 2^k) \geq c\sqrt{\log n/\log\log n})
problemStatement.plain: Is it true that all sufficiently large n can be written as 2^k + m where Omega(m) < log log m? NO - disproved by Barreto-Leeham (2026).
whyMatters: Connects powers of 2 with prime factor counting
Related to Romanoff's theorem on 2^k + p
Uses covering systems, a key tool in combinatorial number theory

proven: erdos_205_disproved: negation of conjecture (PROVED from axioms)
loglog_mono_nat: log log monotonicity for m >= 16 (PROVED)
